provenance.revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: sparse near-plane foreground framing prop for a side-view 2D exploration platformer
Output: exactly one isolated PNG game prop on a portrait 2:3 canvas, genuinely transparent background.
Primary request: Create exactly one connected, ceiling-attached, asymmetrical tattered funerary valance. Along the very top anchor, form a narrow connected cloth header. Concentrate one broad, soft-edged folded cloth strip down one outer side, and place one much thinner torn ribbon near the opposite outer edge. Join the two hanging cloth areas with one loose dark cord arc. The header, side cloth, thin ribbon, and cord must read as one connected decorative prop.
Composition/framing: Show the complete prop, centered and fully inside the canvas with no cropping. Design it for a two-tile-wide by three-tile-tall composition. Preserve a very large uninterrupted transparent opening through the middle so a two-tile-tall player silhouette remains clearly readable through the open center. At least 60 percent of the entire canvas must remain fully transparent. No horizontal area may become a solid curtain or opaque band across the center.
Style/medium: production-ready 16-bit pixel art, crisp stepped pixel edges, deliberate pixel clusters, controlled limited palette, no smoothing and no antialiasing. Soft, limp, folded, frayed and torn textile forms; decorative and non-collidable in appearance.
Color palette: outer cloth silhouette with strong local contrast using near-black navy mass, muted blue-purple fold clusters, and a restrained cool-blue rim. Keep the rim subtle and avoid focal highlights. Cord is dark and understated.
Shape language: asymmetrical, soft, drooping, irregular, clothlike. Broad strip should have rounded/frayed soft tear contours, never sharp or rigid. The opposite ribbon is very narrow and visibly torn. Keep the middle empty.
Scene/backdrop: none; actual transparent alpha background only. No environment or depicted setting.
Constraints: exactly one isolated connected prop; complete subject visible; at least 60% transparent canvas; uninterrupted open middle; readable player-sized negative space; ceiling attachment communicated only by the narrow top header; decorative foreground framing with no collider implied.
Avoid: symmetric arch, solid curtain, opaque center, any horizontal solid curtain band, pointed hazard silhouette, spikes, claws, ribs, platforms, collision surfaces, straight vertical wall, bones, antlers, weapon, character, creature, scenery, ceiling architecture, floor or ground plane, cast shadow, text, symbols, UI, border, frame, watermark, disconnected pieces, extra objects, photorealism, painterly blur, smoothing, antialiasing.
